statement_summary: Information Security Coordinator designated in writing
Written information security program defined (SSP plus three policies)
Annual risk assessment with SP 800-30; risks owned and treated
Risk acceptance authority; High risks never accepted; child-safety risks not above Low
Sanctions for staff; contract termination for contractor tutors; good-faith reporting protected
No written assurances, no children's data; yearly platform SOC 2 review
Annual independent assessment
Annual program evaluation and policy review; policies available to the workforce
Written, risk-rated, time-limited exceptions
Unique accounts; no shared staff accounts
Least privilege: tutors see assigned students only; restricted "Student files" folder; 2 platform administrators
MFA for suite, platform tutors and administrators, scheduling administrator, and MSP-held logins
Offboarding checklist by the last day or last session; contractor deletion confirmation
Monthly account reconciliation against the staff and contractor roster; quarterly assignment check
10-minute device lock; individual sign-in on the front-desk desktop
Named MSP and vendor accounts with MFA; yearly technician list
Password length; student and guest network separated; yearly Wi-Fi password change
Contractor tutors' own computers: minimum device rules; no downloads; yearly attestation
Access only students you work with, only for tutoring
No student information in personal accounts or public AI tools
Lock screens; never share passwords or MFA codes
Training at the start and yearly; phishing simulations
Report suspected incidents at once
Signed acknowledgment (employees); rules in the contractor agreement (contractor tutors)
Contact students only through the platform or in person
Ransomware runbook kept and printed
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log every incident
Record determination and discovery dates; decide whether Florida personal information is involved
Meet notification deadlines in the P08 matrix; counsel review; written no-harm determination
Insurer hotline first; MSP engaged under contract
Ransom payment only with approvals and an OFAC check
Vendor and contractor incident reports logged and handled
Annual tabletop exercise with the MSP
Lessons learned within 30 days
Three classification levels
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit; reports through the parent portal
Restricted data only in approved systems; district data only in the platform
Inventory of devices, services, and children's data
New tools approved with written assurances; no non-integral disclosures without separate consent
Approved AI tools only (none today)
90-day immutable backup versions; quarterly restore test; monthly platform export; weekly schedule printout
Wipe or certified destruction with records; shred bin
Written retention schedule for children's information; yearly purge
Parent requests verified, complete, and logged
Notice and verifiable consent before any child account; new notice for material changes
